examples.en: Promotion here is based on merit.
She got the job on merit alone.
examples.ar: هي حصلت على الوظيفة بالجدارة وحدها.

examples.en: Each case is judged on its merits.
The film has little artistic merit.
The system rewards merit, not age.
He received a certificate of merit.
We should discuss the merits of each plan.
examples.ar: نحن يجب أن نناقش مزايا كل خطة.

examples.en: Merit should matter more than money.
examples.ar: الجدارة يجب أن تهم أكثر من المال.
